To differentiate itself, the company states that it is advancing the development of third-party logistics that efficiently and rationally handle everything from product procurement to retail store shelves, and aims to counter scale expansion by competitors through reorganization by expanding its trading area and scale. In addition, the company states that it will work to stabilize and strengthen earnings and improve its financial position, including cost reductions involving a review of its internal organization.
